summary: Home BancShares filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing receipt of approximately $80.7 million from a borrower's collateral sale tied to a previously disclosed $92.1 million non-performing Texas lending relationship, the first of two resolution phases. Proceeds equaled about 95% of appraised collateral value and cut the principal balance to roughly $11.4 million, still nonaccrual. The credit represented 45.9% of non-performing loans and 37.5% of non-performing assets at September 30, 2026; phase two, expected in Q4 2026, could yield charge-off recovery. No deal terms apply.
